pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Saul and David — the young harper playing before the troubled king who holds the spear, of David the servant of the LORD on the day he was delivered from the hand of Saul, I love You O LORD my strength
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_saul

pictures.scene: Alexander Nasmyth, Hawthornden Castle near Edinburgh — the stronghold set high on the bare rock above the glen, the LORD is my rock my fortress and my deliverer, my God is my rock in whom I take refuge
pictures.name: pd_nasmyth_castle

pictures.scene: Circle of Rembrandt, The Man with the Golden Helmet — the helmet taking all the light above the shadowed face, my shield and the horn of my salvation my stronghold, I will call upon the LORD who is worthy to be praised
pictures.name: pd_helmet

pictures.scene: Paolo Uccello, The Battle of San Romano — the lances lowered and the horses driving in across the field, so shall I be saved from my enemies, the cords of death encompassed me
pictures.name: pd_uccello_battle

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, The Ninth Wave — the survivors clinging to the broken mast as the great wave comes over them, the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me, the cords of Sheol entangled me
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_wave

pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, The Agony in the Garden — Christ on his knees on the rock while the soldiers come up the road behind him, the snares of death confronted me, in my distress I called upon the LORD
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_garden

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, View of a Church Interior — the great white columns going up into the vault with the small figures below them, I cried to my God for help, from His temple He heard my voice
pictures.name: pd_witte_church

pictures.scene: Joao Glama Stroberle, The Earthquake of 1755 — the priest with the crucifix raised among the fallen while the broken church stands behind them, and my cry for His help reached His ears, then the earth shook and quaked
pictures.name: pd_glama_quake

pictures.scene: Joos de Momper the Younger, Mountain Landscape — the great peaks rising over the valley road, and the foundations of the mountains trembled, they were shaken because He burned with anger
pictures.name: pd_momper_mountain_landscape

pictures.scene: Joseph Wright of Derby, Vesuvius in Eruption — the fire running down the mountain into the bay under the moon, smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth
pictures.name: pd_wright_of_derby_vesuvius_in_eruption

pictures.scene: Johan Christian Dahl, The Eruption of Vesuvius — the column of fire and smoke going up off the mountain into the night sky, glowing coals blazed forth, He parted the heavens and came down
pictures.name: pd_dahl_eruption_of_vesuvius

pictures.scene: Giuseppe Angeli, Elijah Taken Up in a Chariot of Fire — the prophet carried up out of the world in the flames with the wheel of the chariot beside him, with dark clouds beneath His feet, He mounted a cherub and flew
pictures.name: pd_angeli_elijah_taken_up_in_a_chariot_of_fire

pictures.scene: Andreas Achenbach, Storm at Sea off the Norwegian Coast — the towering storm cloud over a ship heeling under the breaking seas, He soared on the wings of the wind, He made darkness His hiding place
pictures.name: pd_achenbach_wind

pictures.scene: Gaspard Dughet, Landscape with an Approaching Storm — the great cloud coming on over the open country, and storm clouds a canopy around Him, from the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced
pictures.name: pd_dughet_landscape_approaching_storm

pictures.scene: Martin Johnson Heade, Approaching Thunderstorm — the black sky standing over the water before it breaks, hailstones and coals of fire, the LORD thundered from heaven
pictures.name: pd_heade_approaching_thunderstorm

pictures.scene: George Inness, The Coming Storm — the field going dark under the cloud rolling over it, the voice of the Most High resounded, hailstones and coals of fire
pictures.name: pd_inness_the_coming_storm

pictures.scene: Albrecht Altdorfer, The Battle of Alexander at Issus — the whole plain filled with lances and standards under the burning sky, He shot His arrows and scattered the foes, He hurled lightning and routed them
pictures.name: pd_altdorfer_the_battle_of_alexander_at_issus

pictures.scene: Circle of Juan de la Corte, The Israelites Crossing the Red Sea — the sea standing open and the people walking through on the dry ground, the channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed
pictures.name: pd_de_la_corte_the_israelites_crossing_the_red_sea

pictures.scene: J. M. W. Turner, Snow Storm: Steam-Boat off a Harbour's Mouth — the whole sea and sky turning in one spiral of water, at Your rebuke O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils
pictures.name: pd_turner_snow_storm

pictures.scene: Eugene Delacroix, Christ on the Sea of Galilee — the boat pitching on the green water with Christ in the stern, He reached down from on high and took hold of me, He drew me out of deep waters
pictures.name: pd_delacroix_christ_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, David Slaying Goliath — the shepherd over the fallen giant with the sword in his hands, He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me
pictures.name: pd_rubens_david_goliath

pictures.scene: David Roberts, The Siege and Destruction of Jerusalem — the temple and the walls going up in smoke with the city taken, they confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support
pictures.name: pd_roberts_the_siege_and_destruction_of_jerusalem

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Oxbow — the whole river valley opened out below the storm-swept height, He brought me out into the open, He rescued me because He delighted in me
pictures.name: pd_cole_the_oxbow

pictures.scene: King David Kneeling before an Altar — the king down on his knees at the altar with his crown laid aside and his hands opened, the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot, Le chemin de Sevres — the open road running out through the trees toward the distant town, for I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God
pictures.name: pd_corot_road

pictures.scene: Giulio Clovio, King David Dancing before the Ark of the Covenant — David leaping and shouting before the ark that carries the law, for all His ordinances are before me, I have not disregarded His statutes
pictures.name: pd_clovio_david_ark

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, An Old Woman Reading the Bible — the old woman bent close over the great open book with her hands on the page, and I have been blameless before Him, and kept myself from iniquity
pictures.name: pd_dou_overdenking

pictures.scene: Joshua Reynolds, The Infant Samuel — the child kneeling in the dark with his hands joined, so the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight
pictures.name: pd_reynolds_infant_samuel

pictures.scene: Jean-Francois Millet, The Angelus — the two standing in the field with their heads bowed and their hands folded, to the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless
pictures.name: pd_millet_the_angelus

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Cardsharps — the cheat drawing a hidden card behind the unsuspecting boy, to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_the_cardsharps

pictures.scene: Jacques-Louis David, Belisarius Begging for Alms — the great general blind and holding out his helmet at the roadside, for You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes
pictures.name: pd_david_belisarius

pictures.scene: Hendrick ter Brugghen, Musical Company by Candlelight — the singers gathered close round one candle with their book open between them, for You O LORD light my lamp, my God lights up my darkness
pictures.name: pd_ter_brugghen_musical_company_by_candlelight

pictures.scene: Peter Snayers, The Siege of Aire-sur-la-Lys — the army dug in all the way round the walls of the town, for in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall
pictures.name: pd_snayers_the_siege_of_aire_sur_la_lys

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Wanderer above the Sea of Fog — the man standing on the rock with the mist rolling away beneath him, as for God His way is perfect, the word of the LORD is flawless
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_wanderer_above_the_sea_of_fog

pictures.scene: Guido Reni, The Archangel Michael — the angel standing over the enemy with his sword raised, He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him, for who is God besides the LORD
pictures.name: pd_reni_archangel_michael

pictures.scene: Tintoretto, Moses Striking the Rock — the prophet with his arm flung out and the water running from the stone, and who is the Rock except our God, it is God who arms me with strength
pictures.name: pd_tintoretto_moses_striking_the_rock

pictures.scene: Gustave Courbet, The Death of the Stag — the hounds closing on the stag running in the snow of the high valley, and makes my way clear, He makes my feet like those of a deer
pictures.name: pd_courbet_hallali_van_het_hert

pictures.scene: Alexandre Calame, Landscape with a Small Mountain Lake — the high rock standing firm above the still water, and stations me upon the heights, He trains my hands for battle
pictures.name: pd_calame_mountain_lake

pictures.scene: Piero della Francesca, Battle between Heraclius and Chosroes — the horsemen pressed together with the lances crossing over their heads, my arms can bend a bow of bronze, You have given me Your shield of salvation

pictures.scene: Andrea del Verrocchio, Tobias and the Angel — the angel walking beside the boy and holding him by the hand, Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me
pictures.name: pd_verrocchio_tobias_and_the_angel

pictures.scene: Henri Harpignies, The Rocky Path in the Morvan — the stony track going up between the trees towards the open light at the top of the rise, You broaden the path beneath me, so that my ankles do not give way
pictures.name: pd_harpignies_weg

pictures.scene: Theodore Gericault, An Officer of the Imperial Horse Guards Charging — the officer wheeling his horse round with his saber up, I pursued my enemies and overtook them, I did not turn back until they were consumed
pictures.name: pd_gericault_an_officer_of_the_imperial_horse_guards_charging

pictures.scene: Jan Matejko, The Battle of Grunwald — the commander of the invasion run through in the middle of his own army, I crushed them so they could not rise, they have fallen under my feet
pictures.name: pd_matejko_the_battle_of_grunwald

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, Allegory of the Battle of Lepanto — the fleets locked together on the sea below while heaven is opened above them, You have armed me with strength for battle, You have subdued my foes beneath me
pictures.name: pd_veronese_allegory_of_the_battle_of_lepanto

pictures.scene: Jan van Huchtenburgh, Cavalry Battle — the rider charging in with his sword out over the men already down, You have made my enemies retreat before me, I destroyed those who hated me
pictures.name: pd_van_huchtenburgh_cavalry_battle

pictures.scene: Jan Willem Pieneman, The Battle of Waterloo — the field full of troops with the wounded carried back through the lines, they cried for help but there was no one to save them, to the LORD but He did not answer
pictures.name: pd_pieneman_the_battle_of_waterloo

pictures.scene: Jasper Francis Cropsey, The Clove Storm — the black weather breaking over the valley with the light shut out, I ground them as dust in the face of the wind, I trampled them like mud in the streets
pictures.name: pd_cropsey_the_clove_storm

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — the crown set on the kneeling head before the throne with the saints on the steps below, You have delivered me from the strife of the people, You have made me the head of nations
pictures.name: pd_angelico_coronation

pictures.scene: Jan Gossaert, The Adoration of the Kings — the kings from far countries kneeling with their gifts held out, a people I had not known shall serve me, when they hear me they obey me
pictures.name: pd_gossaert_the_adoration_of_the_kings

pictures.scene: Diego Velazquez, The Surrender of Breda — the keys of the beaten city handed over between the two armies with their lances standing behind them, foreigners cower before me, foreigners lose heart
pictures.name: pd_velazquez_the_surrender_of_breda

pictures.scene: Joachim Patinir, Landscape with Saint Jerome — the great rock standing over the hermit's cave with the storm out beyond it on the bay, and come trembling from their strongholds, the LORD lives and blessed be my Rock
pictures.name: pd_patinir_rots

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned — the figure seated in red under the triple crown with the sceptre in His hand, and may the God of my salvation be exalted, the God who avenges me
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Bartolome Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — the armored archangel standing over the beast with the crystal shield on his arm, and subdues nations beneath me, who delivers me from my enemies
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_saint_michael_triumphant_over_the_devil

pictures.scene: Willem de Poorter, Saul and David in the Cave of En-Gedi — the hunted man in the dark of the cave while the king passes by the mouth of it, You exalt me above my foes, You rescue me from violent men
pictures.name: pd_de_poorter_saul_and_david_in_the_cave

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christ with Singing and Music-Making Angels — the angels singing out of the open book beside the crowned Christ, therefore I will praise You O LORD among the nations, I will sing praises to Your name
pictures.name: pd_memling_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts, Christ in the House of the Pharisee Simon — the woman bowed at Christ's feet with the jar of ointment set down beside her, great salvation He brings to His king, He shows loving devotion to His anointed
pictures.name: pd_bouts_anointing

pictures.scene: Jan de Bray, King David Playing the Harp — the crowned king at his harp with the singers around him, to David and his descendants forever
pictures.name: pd_de_bray_king_david_playing_the_harp

lines.text: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said:
I love You, O LORD, my strength.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer.
My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge,
my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised;
so shall I be saved from my enemies.
The cords of death encompassed me;
the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
The cords of Sheol entangled me;
the snares of death confronted me.
In my distress I called upon the LORD;
I cried to my God for help.
From His temple He heard my voice,
and my cry for His help reached His ears.
Then the earth shook and quaked,
and the foundations of the mountains trembled;
they were shaken because He burned with anger.
Smoke rose from His nostrils,
and consuming fire came from His mouth;
glowing coals blazed forth.
He parted the heavens and came down
with dark clouds beneath His feet.
He mounted a cherub and flew;
He soared on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness His hiding place,
and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced—
hailstones and coals of fire.
The LORD thundered from heaven;
the voice of the Most High resounded—
hailstones and coals of fire.
He shot His arrows and scattered the foes;
He hurled lightning and routed them.
The channels of the sea appeared,
and the foundations of the world were exposed,
at Your rebuke, O LORD,
at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
He reached down from on high and took hold of me;
He drew me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my powerful enemy,
from foes too mighty for me.
They confronted me in my day of calamity,
but the LORD was my support.
He brought me out into the open;
He rescued me because He delighted in me.
The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness;
He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
For I have kept the ways of the LORD
and have not wickedly departed from my God.
For all His ordinances are before me;
I have not disregarded His statutes.
And I have been blameless before Him
and kept myself from iniquity.
So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness,
according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
To the faithful You show Yourself faithful,
to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
to the pure You show Yourself pure,
but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
For You save an afflicted people,
but You humble those with haughty eyes.
For You, O LORD, light my lamp;
my God lights up my darkness.
For in You I can charge an army,
and with my God I can scale a wall.
As for God, His way is perfect;
the word of the LORD is flawless.
He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
For who is God besides the LORD?
And who is the Rock except our God?
It is God who arms me with strength
and makes my way clear.
He makes my feet like those of a deer
and stations me upon the heights.
He trains my hands for battle;
my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have given me Your shield of salvation;
Your right hand upholds me,
and Your gentleness exalts me.
You broaden the path beneath me
so that my ankles do not give way.
I pursued my enemies and overtook them;
I did not turn back until they were consumed.
I crushed them so they could not rise;
they have fallen under my feet.
You have armed me with strength for battle;
You have subdued my foes beneath me.
You have made my enemies retreat before me;
I destroyed those who hated me.
They cried for help, but there was no one to save them—
to the LORD, but He did not answer.
I ground them as dust in the face of the wind;
I trampled them like mud in the streets.
You have delivered me from the strife of the people;
You have made me the head of nations;
a people I had not known shall serve me.
When they hear me, they obey me;
foreigners cower before me.
Foreigners lose heart
and come trembling from their strongholds.
The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock!
And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
the God who avenges me
and subdues nations beneath me,
who delivers me from my enemies.
You exalt me above my foes;
You rescue me from violent men.
Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations;
I will sing praises to Your name.
Great salvation He brings to His king.
He shows loving devotion to His anointed,
to David and his descendants forever.
